verdict.rationale: Pigment documents its own planning-model building: the Modeler Agent builds planning models from natural-language intent, and a function library supplies formula logic. Workforce planning lets users run scenarios to assess different assumptions, which touches hiring drivers. The evidence never explicitly describes driver-based modeling that replaces hard-coded rows, nor growth or price-point assumptions. missing for 10: explicit driver-based modeling documentation, growth-rate and price-point driver examples, hands-on or independent corroboration.
